description:
A reduced-operator rebuild of Microsoft's ONNX Runtime 1.27.0 for Android arm64-v8a.
    This is NOT a fork: the source is upstream onnxruntime v1.27.0, built with
    --include_ops_by_config so that only the operator kernels required by a specific set of
    models are registered. That takes libonnxruntime.so from about 28 MB to about 10 MB.

    IMPORTANT: because operator kernels are pinned, a model using an operator outside the
    configured set fails at session creation, not at inference time. The configured set is:

      ai.onnx opset 11: Add, ArgMax, Cast, Concat, ConstantOfShape, ConvInteger,
        DequantizeLinear, Div, DynamicQuantizeLinear, Equal, Erf, Expand, Flatten, Gather,
        Less, MatMul, MatMulInteger, Mul, Pow, Range, ReduceMean, ReduceSum, Reshape, Shape,
        Slice, Softmax, Sqrt, Squeeze, Sub, Transpose, Unsqueeze, Where

      ai.onnx opset 14: Add, Cast, Concat, Constant, ConstantOfShape, ConvInteger,
        DequantizeLinear, Div, DynamicQuantizeLinear, Equal, Erf, Expand, Gather, If, Less,
        MatMul, MatMulInteger, Mul, Pow, Range, ReduceMean, Reshape, Shape, Slice, Softmax,
        Sqrt, Squeeze, Sub, Transpose, Unsqueeze, Where

    Built MinSizeRel with NDK r27c, minSdk 31, KleidiAI and SVE enabled, ML ops disabled.
    Only the arm64-v8a ABI is included. If you need other ABIs or other operators, use the
    upstream com.microsoft.onnxruntime:onnxruntime-android artifact instead.
